name: manual_b69655
claim: GitHub Dependabot alerts reflect the DEFAULT BRANCH only -- a dependency fix already landed and pushed on a feature branch does not clear the alert until that branch merges to main; don't report alerts 'resolved' based on feature-branch state

decisions.notes: PT reported 8 open Dependabot alerts (2 high, 6 moderate) after pushing fix/pt-standards-convergence-20260818, even though the exact fix (commit 4ae1d1da, ip-address + @hono/node-server bumps) was already in that branch's own history and already pushed to origin. GitHub's alert scan is keyed to origin/main, which still had the vulnerable pinned versions. Also discovered: GitHub's dependency graph for this repo tracks npm/pnpm manifests but NOT uv.lock/pip -- an OSV.dev sweep found a real, separate High-severity pip vulnerability (click <8.3.3, GHSA-47fr-3ffg-hgmw) that never appeared in GitHub's 8-alert count at all. Neither gap is obvious from either data source alone -- cross-check GitHub's authoritative alert list (gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/dependabot/alerts, needs security_events scope or the keyring gh account, not a stale GITHUB_TOKEN env var) AND an OSV.dev sweep of every tracked manifest before declaring vulnerabilities resolved.
